method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98. A layer beside baseline-2026-10 and naive-2026-10, which are unchanged. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Fair Work Act 2009, Compilation No. 73, compilation date 7 July 2026 (register id C2026C00355), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/C2009A00028.txt; Fair Work Regulations 2009 (F2009L02356), Compilation No. 57 (register id F2026C00996), regs 3.01 and 3.06, as deposited at ../../../fair-work-regulations-2009/registers/source-bundle/F2009L02356.txt; Crimes Act 1914 s 4AA (C2026C00368) and the Crimes (Amount of a Penalty Unit) Instrument 2026 (F2026N00424), $364 from 1 July 2026

seat: the individual bringing or weighing the claim: the underpaid or overworked employee, the employee, job applicant or contractor adverse action was taken against, the dismissed employee, the worker bullied at work, the person sexually harassed in connection with work

fwa2-pay.l4: How many hours a week before extra hours must be reasonable
Can I refuse these additional hours
Is my employer breaking the maximum hours rule
Was I paid in full by the due day
Does the way I am paid comply
Is the requirement to spend or pay unlawful
How much am I owed for unpaid overtime
Has my employer committed the wage theft offence
What is the largest wage theft fine
What is the longest wage theft prison term
How much of my claim is left after the casual loading
fwa2-protections.l4: Do I have a workplace right
Was I unlawfully dismissed for being off sick
Was I dismissed to be re-engaged
Did they lie to change my basis
By when must I apply about my general protections dismissal
Is my general protections dismissal application in time
By when must we agree to arbitration of my dismissal dispute
By when must I go to court about my dismissal
Can I take my dismissal dispute to court
Can I ask the FWC about a non-dismissal dispute
fwa2-orders.l4: Can the FWC order my reinstatement
Can the FWC order compensation instead of reinstatement
Who can be ordered to reinstate me
What is the most unfair dismissal compensation
How much unfair dismissal compensation would I get
Is it a constitutionally-covered business
Have I been bullied at work
Can I apply for a stop bullying order
By when must the FWC start on my bullying application
Can the FWC order the bullying to stop
Was I sexually harassed in breach of s 527D
Is the harasser's employer liable too
Can I ask for a stop sexual harassment order
By when should I apply about sexual harassment
Can my sexual harassment application be dismissed as late
Can the FWC order the sexual harassment to stop
By when must the FWC start on my stop sexual harassment application
By when must we agree to arbitration of my sexual harassment dispute
By when must I go to court about sexual harassment
Can I take my sexual harassment dispute to court
fwa2-remedies.l4: What is the largest civil penalty in penalty units
What is the largest civil penalty in dollars
Can I also sue the person involved
Can I also sue the franchisor or holding company
Can I be ordered to pay costs

checks.l4: stable l4 of VS Code extension legalese.l4-vscode 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset
checks.command: l4 run fwa2-pay-cases.l4; l4 run fwa2-protections-cases.l4; l4 run fwa2-orders-cases.l4; l4 run fwa2-remedies-cases.l4; l4 run on each module
checks.result: fwa2-pay-cases.l4 61 of 61; fwa2-protections-cases.l4 55 of 55; fwa2-orders-cases.l4 52 of 52; fwa2-remedies-cases.l4 39 of 39; 0 errors, 0 warnings in every file
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read. A negative control (three altered expected values) gave three failures.

scope: Underpayment and overtime: s 62, s 323 (as a regulative rule), ss 324-326, ss 327A and 546A(2), Sch 1 cl 98, s 545A. General protections and sham arrangements: ss 340, 341, 342 items 1-4 and (2)-(4), 351, 352 with reg 3.01, 357-359C, 360, 361, 365, 366, 369(1)(c), 370, 372. Unfair dismissal remedies: ss 390, 391(1), (1A), 392(3)-(6) with reg 3.06. Stop bullying: ss 789FC, 789FD, 789FE(1), 789FF. Sexual harassment: ss 527D, 527E(1)-(2), 527F, 527G, 527J(1)-(2), 527S(1)(e), 527T. Civil remedies: s 539(2) items 1, 2, 10, 11, 11A, 11B, 27A, 27B, 38, s 546(2), (2A), (2AA), s 546A(1), ss 557A, 557B(1), 550, 558A, 558B, 547, 570. Out: ss 343-350B, 353-356, 362-364 and s 342 items 3A, 4A, 5-8; application fees; FWC procedure and arbitration outcomes; ss 727-734A; other s 539 items; awards and agreements (inputs); everything baseline-2026-10 covers.
